name: vague-brief
description: A one-line brief. The analyst must not invent a product: keep requirements minimal and ask blocking questions about users and core features.

configuration.name: Bright Idea
configuration.description: An app for my small business.

context.goal: A website for the user's small business; the business, its users, and their needs are not described yet.

operations.statement: The website presents the business to its visitors.
acceptance_criteria: A visitor can open the home page and see what the business offers.

questions.why: The users decide every feature and the data the site must handle.

questions.prompt: What must visitors be able to do on the site at launch?
questions.why: Defines the core scope of the first version.

questions.prompt: Do you need to take payments online?
questions.why: Payments add a provider integration and security obligations.

assumptions.statement: The site serves one business, not several separate organisations.

blockers: The users and core features are unknown.

decisions: Did not invent features from a one-line brief; asked about users and core features first.
